name: Tule Springs Fossil Beds National Monument
story: Tule Springs Fossil Beds National Monument is a United States National Monument near Las Vegas, Clark County, Nevada. Established in 2014, it covers 22,650 acres and protects Ice Age paleontological discoveries.
matters: The monument protects part of the Tule Springs in the Upper Las Vegas Wash area, which also includes several patches of the rare Las Vegas bear poppy.
